mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.place_id AS placeId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.content, u.nickname, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
WHERE c.place_id = #{placeId}
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( place_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, content ) SELECT parent.place_id, #{userId}, parent.id, #{content} FROM comments parent WHERE parent.id = #{parentCommentId} AND parent.parent_comment_id IS NULL
